title: EPAN: cleanup proto_tree_add_checksum functions
description:
The following changes were made:
- deep nesting reduced, by removing if-else block.
- use 0 instead of -1 to flag absence of hf_checksum_status header
  field. This in line with current header field not-initialized
  value (0).
- proto_tree_add_checksum_bytes didn't check the zero value checksum
  bytes at all. Implement iterator over checksum bytes and check for
  all zeros.
- use bytes_to_str_maxlen() to create computed checksum string, rather
  than using home grown byte to hex conversion code.
- update API documentation in header file.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

I addressed an issue where a NULL computed_checksum is passed in with incorrect flags that Coverity complained about (not that it happened in practice, but it should be a DISSECTOR_ASSERT.)

!23954
